q1.instructions: Does the code have unit tests that cover it?

criteria.true: Test files exist (e.g. test_*.py, *.spec.ts, *_test.go) and they exercise the changed code.
criteria.false: No test files, or the tests don't touch the changed code.

q2.instructions: Is the code modular and does it follow the SOLID principles?

criteria.true: Small functions/classes with one responsibility; dependencies injected, not hard-coded.
criteria.false: Large functions/classes mixing several responsibilities, or tightly coupled code.

q3.instructions: Is the code readable, with comments where needed?

criteria.true: Clear names; non-obvious logic has a comment.
criteria.false: Unclear names (x, tmp, data2) or complex logic with no comments.

q4.instructions: Is the code free of secrets and sensitive data?

criteria.true: No API keys, passwords, tokens or .env values are written in the code.
criteria.false: Some file contains an API_KEY, password, token or values copied from a .env file.
